test_title: PYST 6 - SSC CHSL 2025 - General Intelligence (Held On: 14 Nov, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question: In a specific coding system, if ENCYCLOPEDIA is coded as FODZDMPQFEJB and DICTIONARY is coded as EJDUJPOBSZ, then what is the code for THESAURUS?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bd3c600bf09d7de25d7d22479d848ddead62c9f7437c41312681e3719e85d12d.png] 

Given:

The logic followed here is that each letter is shifted to its immediate next letter in the alphabetical series (+1 pattern).

**For ENCYCLOPEDIA : FODZDMPQFEJB**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca763dc66e2f4967e0bb3f818d4280edfbda58925e190f64df1bdf77e93e374b.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b8e96075aa60534e702808c095b3799fdc57bb9e9a89073b719cb36aaaa77941.png] 

 

**For DICTIONARY : EJDUJPOBSZ**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/41b8321c8ff806ee6e8e46b6533894c0cdf7fe4491df927a96bf10228b0cafdd.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b8f94feb2aba84767177a500ca9f34f5b8ef5627b95ffc4a2456d926aecc0224.png] 

 

**Applying the same logic to THESAURUS : ?**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/748d5f84494e40d29b3d18705ae33dfabd2b6d469434667f8e84758e60144771.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/33d90bde7305494179d4a24ff547ff95b273779c50ca99101ef51fe1c1a928e3.png] 

 

The resulting code is **UIFTBVSVT**.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1"**.
